note: Human record of the backtest assumptions. build_port_analysis_config reads its defaults from its own signature; a test checks the two agree. Every value is a proposal until the owner accepts it.

region.basis: Lot size 1, no price limit (SRC: Qlib region config).

deal_price.basis: Matches the label (design 4.2); convention C1 decides at the close of t and trades at the open of t+1.

topk.basis: TopkDropoutStrategy(topk=50, n_drop=5), long-only: Qlib cannot short (SRC).

n_drop.basis: TopkDropoutStrategy(topk=50, n_drop=5), long-only: Qlib cannot short (SRC).

benchmark.basis: Must exist in the provider data.

account.basis: Starting cash in USD for the simulation; sets order sizes against min_cost, not a capacity claim.

open_cost.basis: 5 bps per side covers commission and half-spread for liquid large caps. No primary figure for the half-spread was confirmed. Anchor for institutional size: Frazzini, Israel and Moskowitz report mean implementation shortfall of 13 bps on live trades (SRC).

close_cost.basis: Same as open_cost: 5 bps per side, proposed.

cost_stress_per_side.basis: Re-run at 10 and 20 bps per side; a result that dies at double the cost is not a result.

min_cost.basis: Per-order minimum of a retail broker's fixed plan (from a search snippet, unverified).

impact_cost.basis: Qlib's rule: extra fee ratio = impact_cost * (trade value / day's traded value) ** 2 (SRC, not executed). At 10% of the day's volume this adds 10 bps; at 1%, 0.1 bps.

capacity_check.basis: Report cost against impact = Y * daily_vol * sqrt(Q / V), Y of order one (Toth et al., 2011, SRC); Qlib's impact is quadratic in participation and leaves the fill price unchanged.

borrow_anchor_general_collateral_annual.basis: General collateral averaged 17 bps a year in D'Avolio (2002), a dated sample (SRC).

borrow_anchor_specials_annual.basis: Specials averaged 4.3% a year in D'Avolio (2002), a dated sample (SRC).

borrow_stress_annual.basis: Stress the short leg's borrow fee at 1% and 5% a year; borrow is charged outside Qlib by long_short_returns.
